raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the organization recognizing Vince Phillips’ title was the World Boxing Hall of Fame, conflating the sanctioning body (IBF) and the larger Hall of Fame. The correct larger Hall of Fame recognizing the IBF is the International Boxing Hall of Fame. Although corrected later, the first error occurred at this step due to an unsupported assumption.
